# vat Agent Context

> TD-first map for agents. Start from tech design and capability intent before implementation files.

## Tech Design

- [Tech Design](tech-design): implementation source of truth.
- Validate: `aw td check tech-design`.

## Capability Map

- [README](README.md): capability source of truth and product contract.
- [STATUS.md](STATUS.md): support matrix; what each surface does today and the gate that proves it.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): breaking changes and upgrade steps per release.
- Offline usage contract: `vat llm` (`--topic guide` for the full guide).

## Machine, Docker, and K8s

- Host: Apple Silicon macOS only. Linux workloads run in one shared Linux machine (`vat machine`), never on a Linux host.
- Docker: `vat machine start`, then `export DOCKER_HOST="unix://$HOME/.vat/run/docker.sock"` for the stock `docker` CLI, Compose v2, Testcontainers, and SDKs. vat's own Docker users default to that socket; an explicit `DOCKER_HOST`/`DOCKER_CONTEXT` or `VAT_ENGINE=external` opts out.
- Lifecycle: launchd keeps `docker.sock`, so a Docker client wakes a stopped machine. It stops itself after `idle_stop_secs` (default 300; `vat machine start --idle-stop DUR`, `0` = never) unless busy. `vat machine stop` keeps the wake; `vat machine stop --no-wake` drops it.
- Inspect: `vat machine status --json` reports `state`, `docker_ready`, `wake_on_socket`, `idle_stop_secs`, `keeps_awake`, `elastic` (`stopped_by`, `idle`, `busy`, `clock_skew_ms`), `vmm_outdated`, `vmm_staged_sha256`, `vmm_running_sha256`, `ports`, and `data_disk_allocated_kib`.
- Other verbs: `vat machine exec -- <cmd>`, `vat machine env`, `vat machine logs [--vmm]`, `vat machine rm --yes` (deletes the data disk, the launchd job, and the sockets).
- Kubernetes: `vat k8s up` starts the persistent single-node K3s and writes `~/.vat/kube/config` (context `vat`); `vat k8s kubectl -- <args>` runs the pinned kubectl. In `vat.toml`, use `cluster = "machine"`.
- Local GCP: `vat gcp status --json`; `vat gcp env` prints the emulator hosts that host processes share with pods.

## Agent Workflow

- Continue: `aw run --project vat`.
- Next managed step: `aw standardize managed next --project vat`.
- Readiness: `aw health --project vat`.

## Commands

- Build debug: `./build.sh debug`.
- Build release: `./build.sh release`.
- Install: repo root `install.sh --project=vat` dispatches to `./install.sh`.
- Test: `cargo test -p vat`.

## Root Artifacts

- [llms.txt](llms.txt): generated by `aw standardize managed run`.
- [build.sh](build.sh): debug/release build entrypoint.
- [install.sh](install.sh): project-local install entrypoint.
